title: 7 Best Herbal Creams For Sunburn
intro: Herbal creams for sunburn are topical creams or ointments made from natural herbs and plants that provide relief from the symptoms of sunburn, such as redness, itching, and inflammation. These creams offer several benefits, including soothing and calming the skin, reducing pain and discomfort, and promoting the healing process of sunburned skin. Examples of herbal creams used to treat sunburn include aloe vera, calendula, chamomile, coconut oil, lavender, tea tree oil, and vitamin E, among others, which are chosen for their anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that help to reduce redness and promote skin repair. The use of these herbal creams can provide a natural and gentle alternative to over-the-counter sunburn medications, making them a popular choice for those seeking a holistic approach to sunburn relief.

preparations.preparation_desc: Aloe barbadensis creams have been widely used to treat sunburn due to their soothing and anti-inflammatory properties. The gel extracted from the leaves of the Aloe barbadensis plant contains bioactive constituents such as aloin, aloe-emodin, and vitamins A, C, and E, which help to reduce redness, itching, and inflammation associated with sunburn. The moisturizing properties of these creams also aid in hydrating the skin, promoting wound healing, and reducing the risk of further damage from the sun. By applying Aloe barbadensis creams to sunburned skin, individuals can experience relief from discomfort, reduced risk of infection, and accelerated recovery, making it a popular natural remedy for sunburn treatment.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Plastic and reconstructive surgery", Aloe barbadensis creams for sunburn can facilitate faster healing of burn wounds, as demonstrated in a study where guinea pigs treated with aloe vera gel extract healed on average 20 days faster (30 days compared to 50 days in the control group) than those without treatment.

The bioactive constituents of Calendula officinalis creams, including triterpenoids, carotenoids, and flavonoids, contribute to their therapeutic effects by reducing inflammation and promoting tissue repair. The benefits of using Calendula officinalis creams to treat sunburn include reduced discomfort, accelerated healing, and a lower risk of infection, making them a valuable natural remedy for this common summer ailment.
